description: This topic explores Islamic manners (akhlaq) and social dealings (mu'amalat), including honesty, kindness, respect for parents, good neighbourliness, proper etiquette, and the prohibition of harmful conduct such as lying and backbiting.

mcq.questionText: What is the Arabic word commonly used for good character and manners in Islam?
mcq.explanation: Akhlaq refers to good character, morals and manners, which are a central part of Islamic teaching.

mcq.questionText: Which greeting do Muslims commonly use when they meet one another?
mcq.explanation: "Assalamu alaikum" means "Peace be upon you" and is the Islamic greeting of peace.

mcq.questionText: Before beginning to eat, a Muslim is taught to say:
mcq.explanation: Muslims say "Bismillah" (In the name of Allah) before eating, and "Alhamdulillah" after finishing.

mcq.questionText: Which hand is recommended for eating and drinking according to Islamic manners?
mcq.explanation: It is the Sunnah to eat and drink with the right hand as a sign of good manners.

mcq.questionText: Speaking ill of someone in their absence in a way they would dislike is called:
mcq.explanation: Ghibah (backbiting) is mentioning something true about a person behind their back that they would dislike; it is forbidden in Islam.

mcq.questionText: Islam teaches that a believer should treat his neighbour with:
mcq.explanation: Good neighbourliness is strongly emphasised in Islam; the Prophet urged honouring and not harming one's neighbour.

mcq.questionText: In Islam, kindness and obedience to parents is known as:
mcq.explanation: Birr al-walidayn means dutifulness and good treatment of one's parents, a highly rewarded act in Islam.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is considered a prohibited (haram) form of conduct in Islam?
mcq.explanation: Cheating, including in business and trade, is forbidden; the Prophet said whoever cheats us is not of us.

mcq.questionText: The trait of always telling the truth and being trustworthy is called:
mcq.explanation: Sidq means truthfulness; a truthful and trustworthy person is highly valued in Islam.

mcq.questionText: According to Islamic teaching, what should a Muslim do after sneezing?
mcq.explanation: A person who sneezes says "Alhamdulillah" (praise be to Allah), and one who hears responds with "Yarhamukallah".

mcq.questionText: Cleanliness in Islam is regarded as:
mcq.explanation: The Prophet taught that cleanliness (taharah) is a part of faith, covering body, clothes and surroundings.

mcq.questionText: A person who makes a promise but deliberately breaks it shows a sign of:
mcq.explanation: Breaking a promise is one of the signs of a hypocrite mentioned by the Prophet; Muslims are commanded to keep their promises.

mcq.questionText: When two Muslims meet, who is encouraged to give the greeting (salam) first?

options.text: Whoever does so first earns reward; the rider and the walker, the younger to the elder are encouraged to greet
Only the younger person, never the elder

mcq.explanation: Islam encourages spreading salam; the one who greets first gains reward, and there are recommendations such as the rider greeting the walker and the young greeting the old.

mcq.questionText: Which statement best describes the relationship between good character and faith (iman) in Islam?

options.text: Good character has nothing to do with faith
The most complete believers are those with the best character
Faith is only about belief and never about conduct

mcq.explanation: The Prophet taught that the most perfect of believers in faith are those who have the best manners, linking iman closely to akhlaq.

mcq.questionText: Spreading harmful gossip between people to cause enmity is known as:
mcq.explanation: Namimah is carrying tales between people to spread hatred and division; it is a forbidden act in Islam.

fib.questionText: The Islamic greeting "Assalamu alaikum" means "_____ be upon you".
fib.explanation: The greeting wishes peace upon the other person.

fib.questionText: Before eating, a Muslim says "Bismillah", and after finishing the meal he says "_____".
fib.explanation: Saying Alhamdulillah after eating shows gratitude to Allah for the food.

fib.questionText: Speaking about a person behind their back with something they dislike is called _____.
fib.explanation: Backbiting (ghibah) is condemned in the Qur'an and likened to eating the flesh of one's dead brother.

fib.questionText: Islam teaches that cleanliness is a part of _____.
fib.explanation: The Prophet stated that cleanliness is part of iman (faith).

fib.questionText: The Arabic term for good treatment and kindness towards one's parents is birr al-_____.
fib.explanation: Birr al-walidayn means being dutiful and kind to both parents.

fib.questionText: It is the Sunnah to eat and drink using the _____ hand.
fib.explanation: Eating with the right hand is recommended manners in Islam.

fib.questionText: A Muslim who is always honest and trustworthy is described by the quality of _____.
fib.explanation: Truthfulness (sidq) guides a person toward righteousness.

fib.questionText: Carrying tales between people to cause hatred and division is called _____.
fib.explanation: Namimah (tale-bearing) is a forbidden act that destroys relationships.

fib.questionText: The person who sneezes says "Alhamdulillah", and the one who hears him replies with "_____".
fib.explanation: Yarhamukallah means "May Allah have mercy on you", a kind response taught in Islam.

fib.questionText: Breaking a promise deliberately is one of the signs of a _____.
fib.explanation: The Prophet listed breaking a promise among the signs of a hypocrite (munafiq).

tf.questionText: In Islam, good manners (akhlaq) are considered an important part of a believer's faith.
tf.explanation: Good character is closely linked to the completeness of one's faith in Islam.

tf.questionText: Backbiting is permitted in Islam as long as what is said is true.
tf.explanation: Backbiting is forbidden even when true; it is defined precisely as saying something true that the person would dislike.

tf.questionText: A Muslim is encouraged to greet others with the words "Assalamu alaikum".
tf.explanation: Spreading the greeting of peace is a recommended and rewarded act.

tf.questionText: Cheating customers in trade is acceptable if it increases profit.
tf.explanation: Cheating is strictly forbidden; honesty in business is required of every Muslim.

tf.questionText: Being kind and obedient to one's parents is a highly rewarded act in Islam.
tf.explanation: Kindness to parents (birr al-walidayn) is repeatedly emphasised in the Qur'an and Sunnah.

tf.questionText: It is recommended to eat and drink with the left hand.
tf.explanation: The right hand is recommended for eating and drinking; the left is avoided for these acts.

tf.questionText: Keeping a promise is part of good Islamic conduct.
tf.explanation: Muslims are commanded to fulfil their promises and covenants.

tf.questionText: Cleanliness of the body, clothes and surroundings is encouraged in Islam.
tf.explanation: Islam places strong emphasis on cleanliness as part of faith.

tf.questionText: Harming or disturbing one's neighbour is in line with Islamic teaching.
tf.explanation: Islam strongly forbids harming neighbours and commands treating them well.

tf.questionText: Lying is considered a praiseworthy quality in Islam.
tf.explanation: Lying is a blameworthy trait; truthfulness is the quality Islam praises and encourages.

summary.explanation: Akhlaq refers to a Muslim's morals, behaviour and manners.
Muslims greet each other by wishing peace.
Saying Bismillah before eating is part of Islamic table manners.

summary.correctAnswer: Saying something true about an absent person that they dislike
summary.explanation: Backbiting is forbidden and harms the unity of the community.

summary.correctAnswer: Birr al-walidayn, being dutiful and good to parents
summary.explanation: It is among the most beloved deeds to Allah.
Muslims keep their body, clothes and surroundings clean.

summary.correctAnswer: Treating neighbours kindly and not harming them
summary.explanation: The Prophet stressed honouring and helping one's neighbour.
Breaking promises is a sign of hypocrisy in Islam.

summary.correctAnswer: Always speaking the truth and being trustworthy
summary.explanation: Truthfulness leads to righteousness and Paradise.

summary.correctAnswer: The best believers are those with the best manners
summary.explanation: Good akhlaq is a measure of the strength of one's iman.

hoq.questionText: A trader knowingly mixes poor-quality goods at the bottom of the basket and good goods on top to deceive buyers. Which Islamic principle does this directly violate?

options.text: The prohibition of cheating and deception in dealings
The etiquette of eating with the right hand

hoq.explanation: Concealing defects to deceive a buyer is a form of cheating, which the Prophet condemned by saying whoever deceives is not of us.

hoq.questionText: Two friends are arguing, and a third person tells each of them false harmful things the other supposedly said, increasing their anger. The third person's act is best described as a combination of which prohibited conducts?
hoq.explanation: Spreading false statements between people to cause enmity combines lying with namimah, both of which are forbidden and destroy relationships.

hoq.questionText: A student prays regularly but is rude to his parents, insults his neighbours, and breaks his promises. According to Islamic teaching on the relationship between worship and character, what does this show?

options.text: His prayer alone makes his character irrelevant
Good character is part of complete faith, so his conduct contradicts the goal of his worship
Manners are not connected to religion at all
He is excused because manners are optional

hoq.explanation: Islam teaches that worship should produce good character; the most complete believers in faith are those with the best manners, so poor conduct undermines the purpose of worship.
